rmongs pa dang*/ glen pa las thar bar 'dod pa dang*/ lha dbul po dang mi dbul po las thar bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ku las thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o// zhes byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so// de dag la/ sangs rgyas 'byon mthong gtun ri'i rtse las mchongs// ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bzung chos bstan pas// myur ba dgra bcom thob pa ba ku la// skye ngan las sgrol 'dod dgu sbyin la 'dud// zhes so// de ltar gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po re re la yang 'khor mang du 'byung ba thams cad kyang zag pa zad pa dgra bcom pa/ dbang po dul ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i las kho nar brtson pa ste/ 'di dag kyang bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du rga shi med pa'i go 'phang la gnas pa sha stag go /de dag la/ sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul che// bcu drug 'khor du thub pa'i brtul zhugs rnams// khri dang drug stong nyis brgya'i dgra bcom tshogs// lhar bcas skye dgu'i mchod 'os rnams la 'dud// zhes so// de ltar gnas brtan rnams bzhugs gnas spyi mthun par/ dzam+bu gling na bzhugs pa bcu gcig gzhan na bzhugs pa lnga/ 'dzam gling la'ang sa tshigs kyis phye bas yul dbus su bzhugs pa lnga dang mtha' 'khob tu bzhugs pa lnga/ dbus mtha' dpyad dka' ba gcig dbus kyi lnga la'ang ma ga dha'i bya rgod phung po/ drang srong ang+shi raḥste rtse mthon gyi shel nags/ mnyan yod lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug chu bo ya mu na'i gling zhes gaṅgā dang chu klung ya mu na'i bar na yod pa/ ri ngos yangs rnams so// de rnams dbus yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ shar du li kha ra shing 'phel/ lhor 'dam bu'i chu klung*/ nub na bram ze'i grong dka' ba dang nye ba'i dka' ba/ byang du u shi rī ri bo'i bar la yul dbus su 'jog dam pa'i chos 'dul ba me tog 'phreng rgyud las/

li kha ra ṇa tshang tshing nags// li kha ra shing 'phel shar phyogs nyid// ri bo mun pa can gyi drung*// chu klung mun pa can gyi drung*// dka' ba nye ba'i dka' ba yi// grong khyer nub na yod par gsungs// u shi ra zhes bya ba yi// ri bo byang na yod par bshad// de dag gi ni bar rnams la// yul dbus zhes ni gsungs pa de'i// phyi rol mtha' 'khob ces bya ba// bcom ldan mtha' yas mkhyen pas gsungs// zhes 'byung ngo*// yul mtha' 'khob lnga ni gangs ti se/ byang sham+bha la dang nye ba'i ri gangs can/ nub phyogs kha che'i gur gum ri'i rtse mo/ pri yaṅku'i gling*/ rgya gar gyi cha shas zangs gling rnams/ dbus mtha' dpyad dka' ba ri bhi hu la'o// gling gzhan na bzhugs pa ni/ shar lus 'phags gling gi lag na'i ri'i drang srong 'byung ba'i gnas/ nub ba lang spyod kyi 'od zer 'byung ba'i gnas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi spos brtsegs 'od zer/ shar lho siṅga gling*/ lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dben gnas me tog snying po rnams yin/ bzhugs pa'i gang zag kyang spyi dang mthun pa gong du smos pa ltar dang*/ 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod nas ba lang spyod du bhā ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len bzhugs pa sogs ches mi mthun pa'ang 'byung mod/ yul gnas so so de dag nas/ 'phags pa rnams sbyin pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan 'dren pa'i srol thog mar 'phags yul/ de nas rgya nag de rjes bod yul du dar ba yin pas/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ thog mar gnas brtan spyan 'dren tshig 'phags yul nas 'gyur ba ni/ rgya gar skad du/ s+thā bi ro pa ni man+d+ra ṇaṃ/ bod skad du/ gnas brtan spyan drangs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ dgongs nas kyang shel dang nor bu dang*/ dngul dang*/ ku mud dang*/ kha ba'i phung po dang*/ zla ba'i 'od zer dang*/

ston gyi chu dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dri ma med par mdzod la/ rlung gi stobs kyis shing gi lcug phran bskyod pa dang smig rgyu dang sgyu ma dang rmi lam dang*/ glog dang*/ shing rta'i rdul dang*/ ba lang gi phrug gu'i rna mchog dang*/ sbrul gyi lce dang*/ zil pa dang*/ rgya mtsho bskyod pa'i rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i yid skad cig re re la yang mi sdod par 'gro ba/ rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis yud tsam zhig rgyu ba nang du dgag tu gsol/ smras pa/ ri gzar 'bab pa'i dba' rlabs gyur pas kyang*// gang gi dba' rlabs bsgyur la bsgrun med par// 'jigs pa thogs med g.yo ba'i yid de ni// yud tsam rtse gcig mdzod cig btsun pa rnams// zhes sogs nas/ sred pa'i 'dod chags nyon mongs zhags pas gsal zhing sred med la// chu yi chu gter lta bur yon tan rnams kyi gnas gcig pu// thub pa'i sras mchog dge 'dun bdag gis spyan drangs pas// de ring dge ba gang bsags des ni byang chub 'thob gyur cig /ji srid mkha' la 'od 'phro 'od kyis gsal bar rnam par snang byed cing*// ri dwags rtags can 'od kyis ral pa'i dkyil 'khor ldan par 'char ba dang*// rgya mtsho rgyas par gnas pa de srid lha dang lha min phyag byas pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa thogs pa med pa sa la gnas par shog /gnas brtan spyan drangs pa slob dpon bhā ba skan+da bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// ā tsār+ya dzi na mi tra dang ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// zhes sogs mang tsam 'dug pa 'dir yi ge mangs pas thams cad ma bris shing nges shes skye phyir thog mtha' tsam bkod pa yin zhing*/ de dang 'dra bar rgya nag nas brgyud par yang rgya nag thang gi rgyal rabs thang dzu'i dzung gis gnas brtan khyad par gnas pa so so nas spyan drangs pa'i phyir 'phrin yig springs par grags pa'i yi ge yang 'di yin te/

ma ga dha'i yul du byon pa sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun btsun pa gnas brtan chen po rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi dad pa dang*/ dang ba dang*/ 'dun pa las byung ba'i tshig gis gsal bar byed pa'i ngag shel dang nor bu dang kha ba'i phung po dang zla ba'i zer dang pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dri ma med par mdzod la/ rlung gi stobs kyis shing gi lcug phran ltar bskyod pa la/ smig rgyu dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ glog dang sbrul gyi lce dang*/ rgya mtsho bskyod pa'i rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i yid/ skad cig re re yang mi sdod par 'gro ba/ rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis yid gcig pu rgyu ba nang du dgag tu gsol/ lha yi bu mo yid zhum shugs phyungs pa cig zim mer byas pa'i mig /ring zhing gzi ltar bkra la 'od 'tsher mig chags lta ba g.yo ba yi// gang gi thugs ni g.yo ba rgyun gcod rgyu las 'khrugs par ma gyur pa// bdud rnams 'joms mkhas gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa nas/ 'phags pa gnas brtan dgra bcom pa rnams thang zhes bya ba'i ga bor 'byon pa ci gnang*/ zhes pa dang*/ gzi brjid kyi nyi ma stong mthong bar byed pa de dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyi yon bdag ma skyes dgra dang gtum po rab snang la sogs pa bstan pa la dbang ba'i sbyin pa las byung ba'i legs par spyad pa'i rjes su sleb pa/ thang gi rigs mos pa phyir mi gzhol ba'i slad du/ do mod kyi mtshan mo zad par mdzod la/ gdugs kyi dang po la ci bde bar 'dir 'khod par mdzod cig de'i don du hwa shang mngags pa yin/ zhes sogs mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir re zhig de tsam bris pa yin/ thang dzu'i dzung gi 'dz+was paṇ+ḍi ta a ka sha s+thi ras jo bo rje'i mchod khang snye thang 'or gyi sgrol ma gsung byon drung du bsgyur ba yin/ 'di'i rjes la/ yin thang gi gtam rgyud dang*/ 'di'i sngon du thang zam gyis rgya gar nas chos gang na drangs pa'i gtam rgyud/

he ho sran zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i gtam rgyud/ btsun mo'i gtam rgyud rnams kyang yod par grags so// dus re zhig gi tshe rgya nag gi rgyal po snyun gzhi dam pos zin pas/ thabs gang gis kyang ma phan nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsol ba btab pas pho brang dang thag nye ba'i nam mkha' la 'brug gi rgyab yol 'ja' tshon gyi gur gyis brgyan pa byon pa mthong nas gsol ba btab pas khab tu phebs pa tsam gyis rgyal po snyun dwangs/ yang rgyal po bsnyun pa'i tshe blon po rnams kyis/ khyed chos skyong ba'i rgyal po yin na gnas brtan chen po bcu drug bstan pa skyong ba'i phrin las mdzad par grags pas/ de dag 'dir dbyar gnas par gdan 'dren pa'i gsol ba thob ces zhus par rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ bre phul gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi dus su rgya ban smug chas can du byon nas/ rgyal pos khang pa bcu drug brtsegs par bzhugs nas dbyar gnas pa'i dus su/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ yul de'i skye bo thams cad kyis dar dang gos chen dang za 'og la sogs pa'i na bza' mang po phul ba rnams sbyin pa dag pa'i phyir bdag gir mdzad de lhab lhub tu gsol/ dgra bcom longs sku'i cha lugs can du gyur pas na bza'i kha dog dang dbyibs gos 'khyud kyang nges pa med la/ dgag dbye thon nas gshegs par bzhed pa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga chos kyi rgyal po yin pas dbyar gnas par spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa yin/ khyod rnams chos skyong ba'i blon po yin na dgag dbye thon kyang ston 'dir bzhugs par gsol ba thob gsungs pa ltar blon po rnams kyis gsol ba btab na'ang*/ nged cag gling gzhan du sems can gyi don bya dgos pas 'di gcig pur bsdad pa'i skabs med/ nged cig gi sku 'bag re bzhengs shig de yis sems can gyi don du 'gyur gyi gsungs nas 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i gnang ba stsal/

der rgyal pos dbyar khang rer sku 'bag re bzhengs te mchod gnas su bzhugs/ dbyar gnas kyi dus la gnas brtan lung bstan gyi mdo gsungs pas theg pa chen po shin tu dar bar gyur/ de nas lo lnga na sangs rgyas dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad shākya mu ni yang phebs/ rgyal po'i mnga' thang cher 'phel/ rgya nag po'i yul mnga' thang longs spyod che ba yang gnas brtan chen po 'di rnams kyis phebs zhabs kyis bcags pa'i byin rlabs yin par grags/ de'i dus gnas brtan rnams nyin re bzhin hal shan gyi ri la 'chag tu 'byon par/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chos gnas te tā la rab tu gnas pa'i byings las byung ba'i dharma tā las 'phyag dar dang bsnyen bkur stob pa sogs mdzad pa'i dus su srog chags gdug pa can ma rungs pa rnams kyis 'tshe ba bsrung slad/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gcig sprul te phyir bdas pa yin/ nyin re bzhin sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyang mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gseb tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba la rgyun du bzhugs pa yin no// ral pa'i thor cog can go ma'i dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams shing glegs bam khur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sbyong ba'i dus yin par gsungs shing rdzu 'phrul che bas nyin re bzhin yang gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhabs drung du byon nas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad do// de dag la/ ha la shan ri sogs su gnas brtan rnams// zhom ring lhur bgyid snang mtha' mkha' la gzigs// glegs bam la sogs nyer mkho'i chur chen gyis/ gzhar yang ngal med dharma tā lar 'dud// zhes sogs de lta bu'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa la brten rgya nag tu ri mor bris pa/ thags su bskrun pa/ 'bur du bkod pa sogs sku 'bag kyang shin tu dar zhing dus phyis rgya nag gsar ma ta'i ming rgyal po gong ma ye dbang gi dus su'ang*/

ha shang zhig la chad pa'i las che ba 'phog par rgyal po'i bkas bsgo ba la 'jigs pa mi bzod pa dang bcas te song song ba las rgya mtsho'i 'gram zhig tu sleb skabs/ ha shang la brtse ba dang*/ rgyal po de bsod nams dang ldan pa yin pas 'phags pa rnams mtsho'i steng na brgyud de pho brang chen por yud cig phebs pa'i bkod pa ri mor bris pa la gnas bcu chu 'dz+wa ma zhes par grags/ bod phyogs su 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa'i thog ma ni/ mi nyag 'ga'i rgyal po zhig bsnyun par thabs gang gis kyang ma phan nas rgya'i gtam thos pa la brten/ go shir dpe 'dul ba 'dzin pa sogs rgyal po'i mchod gnas rnams kyis gnas brtan gyi cho ga mdzad/ gsol ba btab pas rgyal po bsnyun las grol/ hor dmag gis mi nyag 'ga'i mkhar zhag bdun du bskor te smar chu bskyil nas chu bkag pa'i tshe/ bla mchod gnyis kyis gnas brtan rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ lcags ri'i nang du ban+de rgan po zhig byung nas des chu 'di na yod ces sa brus pas khron pa thon nas mkhar ma shor/ chu zad mi shes pa byung bas hor gyi 'jigs pa bzlog pa sogs byin rlabs che ba la brten/ mdo smad du chos 'di dar ba'i phan yon chen po byung bas gnas gzhi rnams su gnas bcu'i gan+dho la ma brtsigs pa med/ sku bzhengs pa dang*/ mchod pa dang gsol 'debs dar bar gyur to// glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi drug gis mdo smad du byon dus/ gnas brtan gyi che ba gsan par gnas gzhi kun du gnas brtan gyi sku bzhengs skad/ gnas gzhi gtsug lag khang thams cad du bzhugs pa'i srol btod phyis/ khyad par klu mes 'brom chung gis rgya nag tu phyin te bzhugs khang gi sku la dpe blangs nas bris sku bzhengs pa/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dharma tā la te bco brgyad kyi thang sku re bris zin pa byung ba/ lha bzo de yang sprul pa yin nam snyam zer gsungs/

bod du gdan drangs nas yer pa'i ba rang rwa ba na bzhugs pas yer pa rwa ba mar grags skad/ de nas dbu ru'i tshal du bzhugs par grags/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo zhes bya ba klu mes 'brom chung bas rgya'i yig tshang las rnyed pa yod mod/ yig tshang ji ltar rnyed pa yid ches pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas klu mes 'brom chung gis tshigs bcad du bkod pa ni/ 'di skad du/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge'i smon lam dang*// gnas brtan rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rgyal chen bzhi yis thugs dam ji ltar bskul ba'i tshul// sngon byung rgya nag yig tshang nyid las kho bos rnyed// rkang gnyis gtso bo shākya seng ge gtso 'khor dang*// gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// dharma tā lar grub thob chen po hwa shang dang*// rgyal chen bzhi dang thang dzu rgyal po pho brang bcas// gnas brtan rnams kyis rab gnas bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra las// g.yang tse bgyis pa 'di ni kho bo'i yi dam yin// shākya'i rgyal po mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe// dgra bcom khyed rnams mya ngan ma 'da' bar// 'khor ba ji srid bar du bzhugs shig ces// bka' bzhin thub pa'i rgyal tshab nyid du gyur// de rjes slar yang dgra bcom bcu drug po// rlabs chen spyod pa'i pha rol son na yang*// nyan thos tshul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*// zangs gling la sogs gnas rnams kun du bzhugs// khyad par du yang 'dzam gling shar gyi cha// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas// rgya nag bkra shis khri sgo'i pho brang du// spyan ras gzigs dbang rnam 'phrul chos rgyal gyis// zla ba gsum du bkur stis mnyes par byas// tsan+dan a ga ru yi bzhugs khri dang*// dar zab la sogs na bza' lhab lhub phul// rgya nag longs spyod mnga' thang che ba yang*// dgra bcom de dag mchod pa'i phan yon yin// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa du ma bsgrubs nas kyang*// slar yang zhing khams gzhan du 'byon par dgongs// gnas der yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba'i tshe// 'gro ba'i don du zhing khams gzhan du 'gro// bdag gi 'dra 'bag bdag dang khyad med du// byin gyis brlabs kyis de dag bzhengs shig gsungs// de ma thag tu sprul pa'i lha bzo yis// ji ltar mthong bzhin 'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs// bkra shis khri sgor gnas brtan bcu drug po// mngon sum bzhugs ltar dang ba 'dren pa'i sku// lha bcas 'gro ba'i mchod pa rten du bzhugs// slar yang rta dang glang po la sogs pa// sna tshogs bcibs nas nam mkha'i dbyings la byon// de yi sku yang rgya nag yul na bzhugs// gzhan yang gang zag dbang po'i rim pa yis// gzigs pa'i tshul ni du ma nyid du snang*// zhing mchog dam pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang*// bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyi tshul bzung nas// 'gro rnams phan bde'i lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// gnas brtan rnams kyi rnam sprul du ma 'byung*// gang dag thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa sel 'dod na// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi

/gsol 'debs dag la kun tu brtson par rigs// dug lnga bdud bzhi'i sgrib pa gnyis dang ni// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams// ma lus zhi bar 'dod na thub dbang dang*// dgra bcom rnams la gsol ba 'debs par rigs// tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dang*// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams sgrub par 'dod na yang*// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// mchod pa'i sprin phung du mas mchod par rigs// de las byung ba'i dge ba rgya chen des// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pa// dag pa sa gsum dag la gnas nas kyang*// nyan thos tshul 'dzin srid pa ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i// gnas brtan rnams kyi go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa ste snar thang gi chos grwa chen por klu mes 'brom chung gi phyag dpe dngos su bzhugs pa'i steng nas bshus pa las so// zhes 'byung*/ de ltar 'phags pa rnams kyi so so'i rtogs brjod mdo lung las 'byung ba ltar so sor bshad pa bzhin yin cing*/ 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams tshe lo bdun brgya bar gyur pa na/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gis sa'i steng na shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i chos kyi tshogs ji snyed bzhugs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod rten byas te/ der bzhugs pa la kun nas bskor te skyil mo krung bcas pas 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod de phyag byas nas gnas brtan de dag kyang lhag med du mya ngan las bzla la/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten de yang nub nas 'og gi gser gyi sa gzhi la gnas par 'gyur zhing*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro// de nas de'i rjes su rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de nas skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na/

de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa 'jig rten du 'byung ngo*// zhes gsungs/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis bris 'bur gyi sku bzhengs pa rnams kyang*/ 'phags yul gyi lugs bzhengs par 'dod na/ dge slong gi dngos po chos gos rnam gsum bla gos kyi kha dog kyang rdo tshos dmar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ phyag mtshan mngon rtogs dang mthun pa/ 'khar gsil/ lhung bzed/ chab bum/ gtor bu sogs yo byad/ bzhugs gdan nor bu'i khri/ rtswa'i lhas ma dang gding ba/ 'khor rab tu byung ba dang*/ rgya gar ba dang yul tha dad pa'i mi rigs kyis gdugs dang rin po che sogs mchod pa'i rdzas thogs pa/ zhing khams kyi ljongs kyang rgya che zhing yangs par/ grong khyer/ rtswa'i spyil bu/ chu klung ne'u gsing*/ nags tshal sogs rgya gar phyogs dang 'brel ba'i bkod pa gang legs bya/ yang rgya nag lugs bzhengs par 'dod tshe zi thang las 'byung ba ltar/ rgya ban smug chas can gyi tshul/ na bza' yang gos mo chi yug gyon/ phyag mtshan gtso bo mngon rtogs ltar la/ gzhan chu shing dang rin po che'i 'khar ba/ spos snod yol go sogs ma nges pa/ bzhugs gdan nor bu'i khri dang*/ brag dang*/ srog chags 'brug sogs dang*/ pags rigs gos chen sogs/ 'khor brgya'i ban+de mi rigs sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma dang bsil g.yab thogs pa/ zhing khams khang bzangs drwa ba can dang*/ rtswa shing las phug pa sogs ljongs bde zhing yid du 'ong ba bya/ yang bod lugs bzhengs par 'dod tshe/ 'phags pa 'khor bcas gtso bor rab tu byung ba'i dngos po la phyag mtshan mngon rtogs ji lta ba/ na bza' chos gos gsum gtso bor byas pa'i rgya nag lugs kyi gos mo che sogs kyang bya/ gdan khri dang nor bu'i brag mchod pa'i yo byad/ zhing khams gtsug lag khang gangs ri dang yul ljongs sogs bkod pa rten 'brel gang legs bya/ rgya bod kyi lugs gsum ga la nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshul dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur gang legs bya ba ni rten 'brel gyi khyad par du che ba yin/

gnas brtan 'di dag gi sku bzhengs pa phal cher shin tu bgres che ba'i gdong la'ang rus pa'i 'bar 'bur chen po yod pa la/ pags pa srab mos g.yogs par ri mo'i gnyer ma'i sal sul mang po yod pa dang*/ tshigs mtshams rnams su'ang rus pa'i 'bar 'bur mang po yod pa'i tshigs bud pa sla ba nyams pa lta bu dang*/ phyag mdzub rnams kyang tshigs bud pa'i nyams lta bu dang*/ sku'i cha shas thams cad du'ang gnyer ma dang 'bur gob chen po'i nyams chen du bri ba rnams ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myang ba lta bu'i rnam pa can du bris pa snang mod/ 'di ni shin tu rten 'brel mi legs pas/ 'dri ba po sbyin bdag 'brel thogs bcas la nad dang sdug bsngal tshor ba mi bzad pa 'byung ba'i rgyur nges pa ste/ sngon gyi skye bar bhā ra dh+wa dzas pha ma sogs la zas bslangs pa na zas rdo ba zo zhig ces smras pas/ gnas brtan rang gi skye ba 'di dang 'di bcas zas rdo ba za ba'i rigs su skyes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la/ sngon drang srong ser skyas dge slong sde snod gsum pa 'byon pa na/ 'di ni glang po che'i mgo bo lta bu'o// 'di ni rta'i mgo bo lta bu'o// 'di ni rnga mo/ bong bu/ ba lang*/ spre'u/ seng ge stag dom/ dred mo/ gung*/ byi la/ ra lug ri dwags/ ma he/ phag khyi sogs tshig gi mtshon chas pham pa byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ chu klung chen por chu srin nya'i rigs can glang po che rta sogs mgo bco brgyad yod pa zhig tu skyes pa gang gi tshe/ nya pa rnams kyis chu klung yid 'ong ldan du rgya mo spyod pa dang spyod pa chen mo gnyis bcug ste/ spyod pa chen mos ni sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams la tshig gi mtshon chas pham par byas pa'i las kyis rgya mtshor skyes nas/ chu klung der zhugs pa'i chu srin nya'i rigs nyal ba zin ma thub ste/

mi brgya stong phrag du ma ra mdar log pas chu srin de skam la phyung ba nas/ srog chags mgo mang mthong ba mig gi ltar mi bzod pa zhig gyur pa na/ der srog chags brgya stong mang po dang ston pa drug kyang ltad mo'i phyir 'dus so// bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang der gshegs te/ nya pa lnga brgya po la bka' stsal nas/ nya'i phung po dag chur 'jug par mdzad nas/ chu srin de la bu khyod ser skya yin nam/ ser skya lags so// khyod 'di nas gang du skye bar 'gyur/ dmyal ba rnams su'o// zhes gsol nas ngu ba dang*/ nga la sems dad par gyis dang dud 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro zhes chos bstan pas/ chu srin de yang zas bcad de lhar skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ongs te bden pa mthong ngo*// de nas nya pa lnga brgya po dag des yid skyo ste nya par ma gyur na rab tu 'byung snyam mo// de shā ri'i bus shes nas de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du khrid de tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs so// de bzhin du las 'bras ston pa'i mdo sde rnams las rgya cher gsungs kyang 'dir mang du ma spros so// 'phags pa 'di dag sku'i rnam 'phrul du ma ston pa'i phyir/ rgan nas gzhon mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i phyir du/ slan chad sku gzugs 'dri bzo byas pa rnams kyang bgres gzhon dar bab kyi nyams/ mthong na mi mthun med pa byang chub sems dpa'i thig khang nas phyung ba/ nyan thos kyi sku'i rnam pa can mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i sku can du 'dri bar byas na/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rang bzhin yin pas dge legs phan bde'i gzhir 'gyur bar gdon mi za snyam mo// rgya nag lugs la hwa shang dang*/ rgyas par thang dzu rgyal po bri yi/ rgya gar lugs la hwa shang mi 'dri/ de ltar 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyi rtogs brjod go bde sgrub thabs ri mor bya tshul dang bcas pa 'di yang*/

byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo rgya nag 'gyur dang*/ dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod/ 'phags pa so so'i rnam thar 'dul ba lung dang mdo sde rnams las byung ba ltar dang*/ spyan 'dren rgya gar dang rgya nag nas 'gyur ba gnyis kyang 'go smos tsam sogs blo gros spel ba'i sa bon du cha tsam bkod pa yin/ spros pa la dga' ba dang*/ mdo lung spyan 'dren lugs gnyis kyi tshig rigs cha tshang gzigs par 'dod na/ paṇa chen byams gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i mchod chog dang*/ mchims ston nam mkha' grags kyi sgrub yig sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad par zhib tu bltas pas dpyis phyin par 'gyur ro// zhar la/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ 'dul ba lung bzhi dang*/ mdo sde las brgya pa'i sdom tshig ke na ya zhes pa'i skabs su/ bcom ldan 'das yul a du ma na 'byung po'i khyim zhes bya ba'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yul de'i nags khrod zhig tu/ drang srong kai pa'i bu'am kai ne ya zhes bya ba 'khor lnga brgya yod pa zhig dang*/ de dang thag mi ring bar de'i sring mo'i bu drang srong ri bo zhes bya ba 'khor lnga brgya yod pa ste de gnyis gnas so// de gnyis dus dus su rdzu 'phrul gyis mtsho dal 'bab kyi 'gram du 'gro zhing nyin par gnas par byed pa la/ ston pa'i dgongs pas rgyal po chen po bzhi la chos bshad pa dang*/ der drang srong de gnyis kyang tshegs chung ngus thul bar 'gyur ro dgongs pa de rgyal po chen po bzhis khong du chud nas/ g.yog rnams khyed deng la mtsho dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram na song la gdan shoms/ sa gzhi me tog dang spos chus chag chag thob cig drang srong kai ne ya dang ri bo la yang mi'am mi ma yin nam srin po la la dag gnod pa byed na mi rung gis srung ba gyis shig ces bsgos nas/ de dag gis gdan bsham pa sogs byas pa de drang srong kai ne yas mthong nas/

srung ma de la dris pa bas de dag gis khyod la gnod pa byed du dogs pas so// khyed rnams ci shom zhing 'dug des rgyal po chen po bzhi la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos ston pa bzhed de de'i phyir gdan shom mo// des ci ngas de dag la chos bshad dam/ khyod ma yin no// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir ro// khyod 'dir ci zhig la sdod/ khyod srung ngo*// ci'i phyir 'byung po mang po 'du bar 'gyur/ drang srong gis smras pa/ dge sbyong gau ta ma yang srung bar byed dam/ des smras pa/ dge sbyong go ta ma de la su zhig srung*/ de nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad la srung bar mdzad do zhes smra ba thos nas cang mi smra'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das mtsho dal 'bab kyi 'gram du gshegs nas gdan bshams pa la bzhugs pa na/ rgyal chen bzhi rang rang gi 'khor stong phrag du ma dang bcas te lha'i me tog gi rigs dang rin po che dang mu tig dang gser dngul rnams kyis rang rang gi thu ba bkang ste 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das la gtor te zhabs phyag 'tshal zhing*/ ston pa'i sku'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu rim par 'khod do// de'ang yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po la yul dbus pa dang*/ spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras la yul mtha' 'khob pa yin pas de dag gcig shos pa'i skad kyis chos bstan na gcig shos pas brda phrad par mi 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ de dag so so'i skad kyis chos bstan pas/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa chos kyi mig dri ma bral ba skyes nas bden pa mthong nas bstod cing de nas sdod do// de'i dus dge slong rnams kyis rgyal po bzhi'i las ci'i rnam par smin pa zhus par/ sngon bskal ba bzang po 'dir sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus su rgya mtsho chen po na/ klu'i rgyal po dbugs 'byin dang dbugs cher 'byin zhes bya bar skyes/ shing shal ma brtsegs pa na bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang gtsug gi dbang phyug zhes bya ba gnyis kyang skyes nas klu gnyis la gnod par byed pa na/

de gnyis 'jigs nas rgya mtsho'i gting du yibs so// dus gzhan zhig na/ de gnyis sangs rgyas 'od srungs la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi mnos so// de'i mthus de gnyis 'jigs pa dang bral te/ rgya mtsho'i nang nas byung ste bag yangs su 'khod do// de mthong nas nam mkha' lding gnyis kyis gnod pa byar brtsams kyang ri rab rlung dang chu'i shugs rngugs pa ltar gnod pa byar ma nus te rgyu mtshan dris pas/ klu gnyis kyis smras pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs la skyabs su song ste bslab pa'i gzhi blangs pas de'i phyir da ni bdag gnyis la gnod pas mi tshugs par gyur to// bya khyung gnyis kyang dad de/ sangs rgyas dang lhan cig 'grogs nas 'od srungs kyi thad du song ste skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi nos/ klu dang khyung phan tshun mdza' bor gyur nas lhan cig 'grogs shing 'khod de bslab gzhi rnams bsrungs nas 'chi kar smon lam btab pa/ 'di ltar bdag cag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la tshe gcig tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bsrungs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der gtso bor smos par gyur cig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag cag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so// las de'i rnam par smin pas da ltar rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi gtso bor skyes zhes de'i dus kyi klu'i rgyal po dbugs 'byin dang dbugs cher 'byin gnyis ni rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po'o// nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang gtsug gi dbang phyug ces bya ba gnyis ni rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dang rnam thos sras yin te/

de ltar ston pa shākya thub pa nyid kyi spyan sngar rdzing bu dal 'bab tu chos thos bden pa mthong rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob bo// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus la khad kyis nye ba na bstan pa su la gtad dgongs par/ lha 'ba' zhig la gtad na bag med pa mang zhing*/ mi'ang tshe thung ba'i skyon gyi yun du mi gnas/ gnas brtan rnams dang 'od srungs chen po sogs lha mi thun mong du gtad par dgongs/ rgyal chen bzhi la'ang khyed rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas bstan pa srung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal bas rgyal chen bzhis kyang bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes gsol to// de dag la/ rnam 'dren zhal las yul dbus kla klo yi// skad du dam pa'i chos thos chos nyid kyi// bden mthong rdzu 'phrul mthu chen rgyal chen bzhi// bstan pa bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i sde la 'dud// ces bka' sdod rgyal chen dang bcas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa bstan zin to// smras pa/ su zhig dad stobs ldan pas bkod legs gan+dho la bskrun par// ston mchog bstan skyong gnas brtan 'khor bcas dpyod ldan mig gi dpyid// bzhengs par bla bre 'phan gdugs nyer spyod phreng bas mdun bdar ste// bstod dbyangs snyan dgus mchod cing mngon 'dod gsol btab lhur bgyis pas// thog mar dad gus dbang po dul zhi ngur smrig 'chang tshogs 'du// de dag kun kyang yi ge 'dri klog nyan dang don bsam dang*// bsgom pa la brten chos dang chos min rnam par 'byed pa'i blo// 'jam dpal mkhyen dpyod sgrun zlar 'os snyam chos mig dri bral brnyes// rnam pa gcig tu thams cad gzigs pa'i 'jug sgo bzo gso rig /brda sprod sdeb sbyor mngon brjod tshad ma sde bdun yan lag bcas// nang rig chos 'dul mdo sde chos mngon kun gyi lta sgom spyod// yongs kyi gzhung lugs legs rtogs mkhas pa 'jig rten kun gyi rgyan// khyad par tshe 'di nyid sogs mchog dngos sgrub la rdo rje yi// theg pa la zhugs bla ma mchog las dbang bskur legs mnos nas// rim gnyis zab mo'i bsgom bzlas la brten thun mong mchog dngos kyi// dngos grub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa de don gnyis lhun gyis grub// mdor na rgyal dang rgyal ba'i myu gu'i tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan// 'dzin skyong spel la mkhas btsun grub pa mchog gi sar gnas pa// grangs med 'dus pa'i bshad sgrub phrin las mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// nyi ma'i gnyen bstan dri med 'jig rten khams su dar rgyas mdzod// shākya'i sras gyur bdag kyang skyes nas skye ba'i phreng ba kun// dal 'byor lus rten dam pas rjes bzung phyi nang gtsug lag gi

/gzhung lugs rab 'byams thos bsam sgom pa'i snang ba mthar phyin nas// skye 'gro ma rig drung 'byin 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid thob par shog /'jig rten khams kyi mi srun mtha' dag srog gcod 'phrog bcom las// dus mtha'i me yis rtswa sbur ji bzhin thal bar bsregs sbyangs nas// bde dga' dpal 'byor longs spyod phun tshogs dge chos spyod pa rnams// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel la 'gro rnams dgyes dgur spyod gyur cig /ces ston mchog nyi ma'i rtsa lag bstan skyong gnas brtan bcu drug zhabs 'bring dharma tā la/ mi bdag ha shang bka' sdod rgyal chen dang bcas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ sde dge ban tshang mchod dpon sangs rgyas bzang po can gyis chang mi 'thung pa'i dam bca' dang bcas te bskul ba'i ngor/ dkyus su smos pa'i bka' lung rnams dang*/ gzhan yang g.yag sde paṇa chen dang*/ ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang pas byas pa'i rtogs brjod rnams kyi don bsdus te/ rgyal ba zhes pa'i bgrang gzhi'i gro bzhin zla ba'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bsti gnas su/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas sbyar ba 'dis kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa phyogs dang phyogs bral du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
